Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a trust account on behalf of the Washington wing of the civil air patrol.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of a trust account on behalf of theWashington wing of the civil air patrol; adding new sections to chapter43.43 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the Washingtonwing of the civil air patrol is uniquely suited to assist the state inproviding air search, rescue, and emergency services including responseto emergency missions. The legislature further finds that theWashington wing of the civil air patrol is a nonprofit, federallychartered private corporation which is the auxiliary of the UnitedStates air force and is engaged in cooperation with the national,state, and local emergency services.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington state patrol may receive gifts, grants, orendowments from public or private sources that are made from time totime, in trust or otherwise, for the use and benefit of the purposes ofthe Washington wing of the civil air patrol. p. 1 SSB 5636 (2) The chief of the Washington state patrol or the chief'sdesignee shall deposit moneys received under subsection (1) of thissection into the Washington wing of the civil air patrol accountcreated in section 3 of this act. (3) The chief of Washington state patrol or the chief's designeeshall disperse the donated funds to the Washington wing of the civilair patrol for the following purposes: Equipment purchase, conduct ofsearch and rescue missions, and training and education.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington wing of the civil air patrol account is created inthe custody of the state treasurer. All receipts from public andprivate contributions to the Washington wing of the civil air patrolmust be deposited into the account. Expenditures from the account maybe used only for the purposes of section 2 of this act. Only the chiefof the Washington state patrol or the chief's designee may authorizeexpenditures from the account. The account is subject to allotmentprocedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is notrequired for expenditures.
